name: make-it-a-bit-better
description: An autonomous product-polish loop: every round opens a mandatory fresh brainstorm (3 perspective subagents), picks one small angle, implements, verifies and commits it, and logs it in a per-project ledger; oversized ideas go to an icebox. A bit better, round after round.

description_i18n.en: An autonomous product-polish loop: every round opens a mandatory fresh brainstorm (3 perspective subagents), picks one small angle, implements, verifies and commits it, and logs it in a per-project ledger; oversized ideas go to an icebox. A bit better, round after round.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 自主产品打磨循环：每轮强制开一场新头脑风暴（3 个视角子代理），择一个小角度实现、验证并提交，落账到项目级 ledger；超格好想法进 icebox。一轮好一点点，轮次积累成产品进步。
